summary: Rectangular universal plate with a regular grid of 3 mm through holes at 5 mm pitch (31 columns by 11 rows). The model is centered at the origin, with length along x, width along y and thickness along z. The set also includes angle brackets, shaft mounts and hardware, which are not modeled here.

Bottom flat face of the plate, with the hole grid for mounting components

notes: The 160 x 60 mm outline is vendor data marked unverified, and no drawing shows these dimensions. The 3 mm hole diameter, 5 mm pitch and 11 x 31 grid count come from the spec text, and the image looks consistent with them. Plate thickness is not stated or visible, so z = 2 mm is a placeholder to be checked against the real part. The holes array lists only the four corner holes. The full pattern is every combination of x = -75 to 75 mm and y = -25 to 25 mm in 5 mm steps, which is 341 holes at z = 0. This assumes the grid is centered on the plate, so the edge margin would be 5 mm on all sides. Sprue-attached pegs and tabs visible in the photo are molding artifacts and are ignored.
